description: Org Self-Optimizer (#830, org-optimizer-14) — reads the org audit snapshot (agent profiles, skills, delegation graph, recipes, webhook wiring, denied-tool telemetry) and writes low/high-risk proposals to the review queue. READ-AUDIT + WRITE-PROPOSALS ONLY. It can never create an agent, grant/expand delegation, broaden a scope, create a webhook endpoint, or adopt external code directly from its own tool surface — those are HIGH-risk proposal kinds per docs/ai/decisions/2026-06-29-org-self-optimizer-cron.md and are only ever applied server-side, behind the human-gate queue, after explicit approval.

hardExclusions: No agent_configs write tool — create-agent proposals are queued, never applied from this profile's tool surface.
No delegation-grant tool — grant-delegation/expand-delegation proposals are queued.
No webhook-endpoint-create tool — webhook-wiring proposals are queued and fenced (#737).
No external install tool (mcp-registry disabled here) — external-adoption is the SEPARATE org-external-discovery role's job, and even there adoption is queue-only.
notes.why-read-audit-write-proposals-only: Safety invariant #6 (decision doc): the optimizer's own agent tool surface can read signals and (via the server-side run loop, not a direct tool call) write agent_org_proposals rows for low-risk auto-apply or the human-gate queue. It never holds a tool that performs a privileged write itself.
